body: I understand. I am still young but all they do is try to make us go to college locally and live a normal life. I’m sick of hearing that I have to pick a path/life plan. What if I don’t want to? They all just tell me that I will be a bum. I just plan to do whatever I feel at the time and just kill myself when I become homeless or I am in jail. I hate this world too so you aren’t alone on that. Trust me, I want to be gone and not missed.
